answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a slashable stake tied to one unique attestation per agent. Each identity locks collateral behind a hardware-rooted cipher and waits weeks to withdraw. Rewards grow sublinearly and are voided for identities sharing one funding source, so a fake farm posts a bond per account and loses every bond if one double-votes. Minting a thousand agents to skim the nectar of rewards still costs a thousand deposits, and the common origin shows as clearly as shale bands in a cliff. With payout per head capped, the bill outruns the loot and the raid never pays for itself.
